data.body: Merged to main: origin/main tip 5f9c9e541d (PR #515 staged->main). Fix commits a91062ef34 (5-axis) + 1d58a2b072 (Axis-5 restore) confirmed ancestors of main. Two-channel route used: PR #513 feature->staged, PR #516 axis5-fix->staged (after CI llm-review caught the missing Axis-5 guard as a true positive), PR #515 staged->main auto-merged green. PR #514 (promote-* head) closed — wrong head shape for check-staged-head. Remote fix branches deleted on merge.
